name: KYC-Refresh-Bot
description: Scans the customer master, picks customers due for KYC re-verification based on risk category, emails document requests and updates the KYC status in the core banking system.

name: STR-Filer-Bot
description: Collects flagged suspicious transactions from the monitoring queue, prepares the suspicious transaction report and submits it to the FIU portal.

name: Sanctions-Screening-Bot
description: Screens customer names against sanctions and watch lists, logs hits for analyst review.

name: Loan-Disbursal-Bot
description: Validates approved loan applications, checks the customer risk category and KYC status, and triggers disbursal to the customer account.

name: FX-Derivative-Booking-Bot
description: Books foreign exchange derivative contracts for customers and handles cancellation, rebooking and rollover on maturity.

name: Hedge-Limit-Checker-Bot
description: Checks customers' open INR forex positions against the threshold allowed without proof of underlying exposure.

name: Hedge-Documentation-Bot
description: Collects customer documents and undertakings at deal confirmation and archives them for audit.

name: KYC-Document-Verification-Bot
description: Verifies identity documents during account opening and accepts overseas-certified copies for non-resident customers.

name: Deposit-Rate-Bot
description: Computes interest rates on NRE, NRO and FCNR(B) deposits and applies the rate ceilings before posting rate changes.

name: Payments-Rate-Disclosure-Bot
description: Publishes the deposit interest rate schedule on the bank website and sends notices when rates change.

name: CTR-Reporting-Bot
description: Collects monthly cash transactions above the reporting threshold and submits the cash transaction report to FIU-IND.

name: Loan-Repricing-Bot
description: Resets the interest rate on floating rate loans that are linked to an external benchmark.

name: Card-Limit-Bot
description: Assigns and revises unsecured credit limits on credit cards at onboarding and on periodic review.

name: Grievance-Bot
description: Logs customer complaints, sends the acknowledgement and tracks each complaint to closure.

name: Cheque-Clearing-Bot
description: Processes cheques in the clearing cycle and credits the proceeds to the customer account.

name: Record-Retention-Bot
description: Archives customer identification and transaction records and purges them when the retention period ends.

name: Fraud-Reporting-Bot
description: Prepares the fraud monitoring return and reports detected frauds to the regulator.

name: Dormant-Account-Bot
description: Flags accounts with no customer-induced transactions as inoperative and notifies the customer.
